# `preprocess_data/crc_visiumhd/` — generated by the workflow

> The optional pre-extracted UNI grid is included in the single archive linked in the
> root README. This file documents the expected filenames and stage outputs.

All subdirectories ship **empty** except for a `.gitkeep`. Each is filled by one
pipeline stage; `uni/` is the only one you may need to populate from a download.

| Subdirectory  | Filled by                                | Contents |
|---------------|------------------------------------------|----------|
| `uni/`        | `prepare_crc_visiumhd_uni.sh`, **or** the root archive | `superpixel_features.npy` `(912, 1008, 1536)`, `superpixel_coordinates.npz`, `extraction_metadata.json` |
| `bcam_input/` | `prepare_crc_visiumhd_bcam_input.sh`     | `gene_expression_normalized.npy` `(545613, 2500)`, `uni2_features_per_cell.npy` `(545613, 1536)`, `cell_coords_standardized.npy`, `gene_names.npy`, `cell_ids.npy`, `superpixel_mapping.npy`, `svg_genes_info.csv`, `preprocessing_metadata.json` |
| `inr_output/` | `reproduce_crc_visiumhd_inr.sh`          | `inr_reconstructed_expression.npy` `(545613, 2500)`, `snapshots/model_epoch_*.pt`, `coords_01.npy`, `coords_original.npy`, `train_log.csv`, `inr_training_info.json` |
| `bcam_output/`| `reproduce_crc_visiumhd_fusion.sh`       | `fusion_latent_512.npy` `(545613, 512)`, `fusion_latent_512_smooth.npy`, `fusion_predicted_expression.npy`, `checkpoints/fusion_epoch_*.pt`, `training_info.json` |
| `viz/`        | `reproduce_crc_visiumhd_cluster.sh`      | `kmeans_labels_K15.npy`, `labels_fusion_K15.npy`, `domain_map_K15.{png,pdf}`, `clustering_K15_overview.png`, `cluster_summary.json` |

Expect roughly 20 GB in total for a full run.
